## Separation rule

One principal may hold multiple roles, but every role retains its own scope, decision record, evidence requirements, and claim ceiling. Architecture, context meaning, local language, relationship mapping, capability instances, migration intent, lineage evidence, source admission, semantic promotion, and conformance remain independent authorities; no field or role is silently inferred from another. Craft Product ownership does not imply Definition admission or Bounded Context ownership.

## Claim ceiling

This prospective owner-registry postimage preserves the fifteen admitted assignments and adds one exact Craft Product role binding only if CAL-DECISION-0028 is admitted. It grants no Definition, source, context, implementation, publication, or deployment authority.
